dfz7nkcpg48xfINSERT INTO GLBTRNVALIDRES(ACMASTCODE, AC_NO, MSGCD, MSGDESCR, WARNINGMSG) SELECT :"SYS_B_00", :"SYS_B_01", :"SYS_B_02", :"SYS_B_03"||NAME||:"SYS_B_04"||ACCNT||:"SYS_B_05"||TOTODAMT, :"SYS_B_06" FROM ( SELECT A.ACCNT, A.TOTODAMT, A.GMST_CODE, B.NAME FROM ( SELECT :"SYS_B_07", :"SYS_B_08", COUNT(DISTINCT B.ACMASTCODE*:"SYS_B_09"+B.AC_NO) AS ACCNT, SUM(DECODE(NVL(B.OVERDUEAMT, :"SYS_B_10"), :"SYS_B_11", NVL(B.PEND_INST, :"SYS_B_12"), NVL(B.OVERDUEAMT, :"SYS_B_13"))) AS TOTODAMT, B.GMST_CODE FROM VIEWLNMAS B WHERE NVL(B.CLOSED, :"SYS_B_14") <> :"SYS_B_15" AND NVL(B.POST, :"SYS_B_16")= :"SYS_B_17" AND B.GMST_CODE=:"SYS_B_18" GROUP BY B.GMST_CODE HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT B.ACMASTCODE*:"SYS_B_19"+B.AC_NO)>:"SYS_B_20" ) A , BANKMAS B WHERE A.GMST_CODE=B.GMST_CODE AND NVL(A.TOTODAMT, :"SYS_B_21")>:"SYS_B_22" )

dwvb7w0v0tncf SELECT SUM(NVL(CREDIT, :"SYS_B_000")) FROM ( SELECT TDATE, OTRNNO AS TRN_NO, ACMASTCODE, AC_NO, DEBIT, CREDIT, DRCR, CSH_TRN, PRTCLS, ATBRANCH FROM ACBK WHERE TDATE = TO_DATE(:"SYS_B_001") AND ACMASTCODE=:"SYS_B_002" AND NVL(CNCLED, :"SYS_B_003")=:"SYS_B_004" AND NVL(POST, :"SYS_B_005")=:"SYS_B_006" AND NVL(CREDIT, :"SYS_B_007")<>:"SYS_B_008" AND BRANCHCODE=:"SYS_B_043" UNION ALL SELECT TDATE, TRN_NO, ACMASTCODE, AC_NO, DEBIT, CREDIT, DRCR, CSH_TRN, PRTCLS, ATBRANCH FROM (SELECT A.ENT_DATE AS TDATE, OTRNNO AS TRN_NO, B.ACMASTCODE, A.AC_NO, DECODE(GREATEST(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_044")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_045"), :"SYS_B_046"), :"SYS_B_047", :"SYS_B_048", NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_049")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_050")) AS DEBIT, DECODE(GREATEST(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_051")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_052"), :"SYS_B_053"), :"SYS_B_054", ABS(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_055")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_056")), :"SYS_B_057") AS CREDIT, DECODE(B.AC_TYPE, :"SYS_B_058", :"SYS_B_059", DECODE(GREATEST(NVL(ACCINT, :"SYS_B_060")+NVL(INTAFTMAT, :"SYS_B_061"), :"SYS_B_062"), :"SYS_B_063", :"SYS_B_064", :"SYS_B_065")) AS DRCR, :"SYS_B_066" AS CSH_TRN, :"SYS_B_067" PRTCLS, A.BRANCHCODE AS ATBRANCH FROM INDPRO A, ACMAST B WHERE A.ENT_DATE = TO_DATE(:"SYS_B_068") AND A.AC_CODE=B.AC_CODE AND B.ACMASTCODE=:"SYS_B_069" AND NVL(A.POST,           Findings and Recommendations
          ----------------------------

Finding 1: Top SQL Statements
Impact is 1.87 active sessions, 18.95% of total activity.
---------------------------------------------------------
SQL statements consuming significant database time were found. These
statements offer a good opportunity for performance improvement.

   Recommendation 1: SQL Tuning
   Estimated benefit is .78 active sessions, 7.9% of total activity.
   -----------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Investigate the UPSERT statement with SQL_ID "85g4cnkgxqbns" for
      possible performance improvements. You can supplement the information
      given here with an ASH report for this SQL_ID.
      Related Object
         SQL statement with SQL_ID 85g4cnkgxqbns.
         MERGE INTO FDACCINTMAS T
         USING (SELECT * FROM FDMAS WHERE ACMASTCODE = 360 AND NVL(CLOSED,0)
         <> 1) S
         ON (T.ACMASTCODE = S.ACMASTCODE AND T.AC_NO=S.AC_NO)
         WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE SET T.ACC_INT = 0,T.TRNSCNID=NVL(T.TRNSCNID,0)+1
         WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT (T.ACMASTCODE,T.AC_NO,T.ACC_INT,T.BRANCHCODE,T.TRNSCNID)
         VALUES (S.ACMASTCODE,S.AC_NO,0,S.BRANCHCODE,1)
   Rationale
      The SQL spent only 27% of its database time on CPU, I/O and Cluster
      waits. Therefore, the SQL Tuning Advisor is not applicable in this case.
      Look at performance data for the SQL to find potential improvements.
   Rationale
      Database time for this SQL was divided as follows: 95% for SQL
      execution, 0% for parsing, 5% for PL/SQL execution and 0% for Java
      execution.
   Rationale
      SQL statement with SQL_ID "85g4cnkgxqbns" was executed 337 times and had
      an average elapsed time of 7.4 seconds.
   Rationale
      Waiting for event "enq: TX - row lock contention" in wait class
      "Application" accounted for 72% of the database time spent in processing
      the SQL statement with SQL_ID "85g4cnkgxqbns".
   Rationale
      Top level calls to execute the PL/SQL statement with SQL_ID
      "54q2rrwbrjn1z" are responsible for 70% of the database time spent on
      the UPSERT statement with SQL_ID "85g4cnkgxqbns".
      Related Object
         SQL statement with SQL_ID 54q2rrwbrjn1z.
         BEGIN PKG_CBVER02_FINDPRO.GET_ACDETAILS(:1,:2,:3,:4,:5,:6); END;

         SQL statement with SQL_ID 8as8s1k2fhhqb.

      Related Object

         MERGE INTO FDACCINTMAS T
         USING (SELECT * FROM FDMAS WHERE ACMASTCODE = 360 AND NVL(CLOSED,0)
         <> 1) S
         ON (T.ACMASTCODE = S.ACMASTCODE AND T.AC_NO=S.AC_NO)
         WHEN MATCHED THEN
         UPDATE SET T.ACC_INT = 0,T.TRNSCNID=NVL(T.TRNSCNID,0)+1
         WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
         INSERT (T.ACMASTCODE,T.AC_NO,T.ACC_INT,T.BRANCHCODE,T.TRNSCNID)
         VALUES (S.ACMASTCODE,S.AC_NO,0,S.BRANCHCODE,1)
